units.text: INT. GHOSTS - CONTINUOUS
Ay, you may well say that, Engstrand.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: And to think that such a thing should happen to a benevolent Institution, that was to have been a blessing both to town and country, as the saying goes! The newspapers won't be for handling your Reverence very gently, I expect.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: No; that is just what I am thinking of. That is almost the worst of the whole matter. All the malignant attacks and imputations--! Oh, it makes me shudder to think of it!
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Comes in from the garden.
He is not to be persuaded to leave the fire.
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: Ah, there you are, Mrs. Alving.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: So you have escaped your Inaugural Address, Pastor Manders.
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: Oh, I should so gladly--
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: In an undertone.
It is all for the best. That Orphanage would have done no one any good.
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: Do you think not?
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Do you think it would?
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: It is a terrible misfortune, all the same.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Let us speak of it plainly, as a matter of business.--Are you waiting for Mr. Manders, Engstrand?
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: At the hall door.
That's just what I'm a-doing of, ma'am.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Then sit down meanwhile.
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: Thank you, ma'am; I'd as soon stand.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: To MANDERS.
I suppose you are going by the steamer?
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: Yes; it starts in an hour.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Then be so good as to take all the papers with you. I won't hear another word about this affair. I have other things to think of--
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: Mrs. Alving--
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Later on I shall send you a Power of Attorney to settle everything as you please.
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: That I will very readily undertake. The original destination of the endowment must now be completely changed, alas!
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Of course it must.
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: I think, first of all, I shall arrange that the Solvik property shall pass to the parish. The land is by no means without value. It can always be turned to account for some purpose or other. And the interest of the money in the Bank I could, perhaps, best apply for the benefit of some undertaking of acknowledged value to the town.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Do just as you please. The whole matter is now completely indifferent to me.
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: Give a thought to my Sailors' Home, your Reverence.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Upon my word, that is not a bad suggestion. That must be considered.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Oh, devil take considering--Lord forgive me!
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: With a sigh.

And unfortunately I cannot tell how long I shall be able to retain control of these things--whether public opinion may not compel me to retire. It entirely depends upon the result of the official inquiry into the fire--
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: What are you talking about?
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: And the result can by no means be foretold.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Comes close to him.
Ay, but it can though. For here stands old Jacob Engstrand.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Well well, but--?
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: More softy.
And Jacob Engstrand isn't the man to desert a noble benefactor in the hour of need, as the saying goes.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Yes, but my good fellow--how--?
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Jacob Engstrand may be likened to a sort of a guardian angel, he may, your Reverence.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: No, no; I really cannot accept that.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Oh, that'll be the way of it, all the same. I know a man as has taken others' sins upon himself before now, I do.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Jacob!
units.name: MANDERS
